python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
last=['baseline dot','baseline dot','baseline dot','baseline dot','raised dot','baseline dot']
for i,(a,m) in enumerate(zip(items[80:],last),80):
 answers.append(dict(item_id=a['item_id'],answer=next(k for k,v in a['options'].items() if v==m),confidence='low' if i==84 else 'high',note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in answers:f.write(json.dumps(a)+'\n')
checked=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(checked)==len(items)==86
for item,a in zip(items,checked):
 assert a['item_id']==item['item_id']
 assert a['answer'] in item['options']
 assert a['confidence'] in ('high','low')
 assert set(a)=={'item_id','answer','confidence','note'}
print('Verified count, order, letters:',len(checked))
print(dict(collections.Counter(i['options'][a['answer']] for i,a in zip(items,checked))))
print('Low confidence:',sum(a['confidence']=='low' for a in checked))
